definitions.explanation: A formal or official term for rainy weather. Commonly seen in announcements and signage about weather-dependent events.

examples.japanese: {雨天|うてん}の{場合|ばあい}は{体育館|たいいくかん}で{行|おこな}います。
examples.english: In the event of rain, it will be held in the gymnasium.

examples.japanese: {雨天|うてん}{決行|けっこう}ですので、{傘|かさ}をお{持|も}ちください。
examples.english: The event will proceed rain or shine, so please bring an umbrella.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word seen mostly in written announcements, event notices, and weather reports. In everyday conversation, {雨|あめ} is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨天|うてん}{中止|ちゅうし} (canceled in case of rain)
- {雨天|うてん}{決行|けっこう} (will proceed rain or shine)
- {雨天|うてん}の{場合|ばあい} (in the event of rain)
- {雨天|うてん}{順延|じゅんえん} (postponed to the next clear day)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{雨天|うてん} is formal/written; {雨|あめ} is the everyday word. {雨天|うてん} appears on signs and posters, not in casual speech.
